title: Chip Industry Week In Review Highlights AI and Packaging
summary: Recent developments include HBM shortages threatening AI expansion, TSMC weighing price hikes, and Intel's move into quantum.

title: Cadence Joins DOE Genesis Mission Consortium
summary: Cadence will contribute AI-enabled EDA and digital twin technologies to support national laboratory research.

title: Intel Reports Q3 Revenue of $16.5 Billion
summary: Intel posted $16.5 billion in Q3 revenue but issued a disappointing Q4 forecast between $15 billion and $16 billion.

title: 19th-Century Dogtrot House Becomes Prefab Passive House
summary: Williamson Williamson combined prefabricated construction and a high-insulation envelope to adapt a traditional dogtrot layout for Ontario.

title: US DIA Releases Image of China's Secret Spaceplane
summary: A commercial satellite captured the clearest public view yet of China's secretive orbital spaceplane from 56 miles away.

title: White House Issues Section 232 Ruling on Foreign Robots
summary: The U.S. secretary of commerce concluded that reliance on robotics imports presents a national security risk.

title: ETH Zurich Researchers Use Bacteria to Bind Sand
summary: Researchers at ETH Zurich are using bacteria to bind sand grains together as a sustainable alternative to conventional cement.

title: 2026 Robotics Handbook Explores Humanoids and AI
summary: The 2026 Robotics Handbook examines design choices behind dexterous manipulation, humanoid robots, and construction automation.

title: Intel and SAP Integrate AI Warehouse Robots
summary: A proof of concept links business-governed warehouse transport tasks to autonomous robots and reports execution status to management software.

title: Virgin Galactic Unveils Apeiron Rocket Plane
summary: Virgin Galactic introduced Apeiron, a new rocket plane designed to carry six passengers to the edge of space.

title: SwapBot Enables Tool-Centric Robot Manipulation
summary: Researchers introduced SwapBot, a modular end-effector system with interchangeable adapters and tactile sensors for versatile robot tasks.

title: SymAnt Grounds Long-Horizon Action Anticipation
summary: SymAnt is a neuro-symbolic approach that unifies neural networks with symbolic priors to anticipate long sequences of future actions.

title: Conveyor Belt Mechanism for Continuum Robots
summary: A novel conveyor belt mechanism enables continuous, active repositioning of functional elements along tendon-driven continuum robots.

title: Analog Realization of Aliev-Panfilov Oscillator
summary: A single resistor moves a discrete analog realization of a forced Aliev-Panfilov excitable oscillator from a chaotic to a regular operating point.

title: Deep Learning Clutter Suppression for Multistatic ISAC
summary: New deep learning methods improve target localization and velocity estimation by suppressing dense clutter in multistatic ISAC systems.

title: Tutorial on Shape Servoing of Deformable Objects
summary: This tutorial covers the fundamentals of data-driven Jacobian-based shape control for the automated manipulation of deformable objects.

title: Behavioral Approach to Constrained Linear Quadratic Control
summary: This paper develops a constrained linear-quadratic optimal control framework within the behavioral approach using quadratic differential forms.

title: Two-Wheeled Quadrotor with Tilted Rotors for Surface Locomotion
summary: A proposed wheeled quadrotor with all-clockwise tilted rotors uses surface contact constraints to generate propulsion without tilting the vehicle.

title: Fundamental Limits of Sampling-Based Reachability Analysis
summary: This study analyzes geometric error in sampling-based reachability estimation as a problem of support estimation under flow distortion.

title: Adaptive Search with Path-Constrained Mobile Sensors
summary: Researchers cast active path selection for energy-constrained mobile sensors as a multi-armed bandit problem and propose an iterative search algorithm.

title: Improving Fine-Grained Robot Manipulation via DEED Framework
summary: The DEED framework adapts pretrained vision-language-action policies for fine-grained manipulation through structured demonstration expansion and execution design.

title: Optimal UAV Path Planning with Localization Constraints
summary: A proposed localization-constrained A* planner treats uncertainty as a hard constraint to find reliable UAV paths in GPS-denied areas.

title: Continuous-Action World Models for Cross-Embodiment Robotics
summary: Continuous-Action World Models introduce a shared latent function space to support robot action generation across diverse embodiments and frequencies.

title: Arctic Fox Introduces Super Mouse with Built-in Touchscreen
summary: Arctic Fox is launching its Super Mouse featuring a built-in touchscreen designed to improve workflow speed.

title: Finite-Sample LTI System Identification from Misspecified Models
summary: This paper investigates finite-sample identification of unknown LTI systems when the true system does not belong to the hypothesis class.

title: Securing the Robotics Supply Chain and Research Agenda
summary: This paper outlines a sustained federal investment agenda needed over the next decade to secure the robotics supply chain and research gaps.

title: HiFOR: Hierarchical Foresight for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: HiFOR is a hierarchical foresight framework that uses action-guided world retrieval to enhance robotic manipulation policies.

title: EpiCoach: Agentic Bayesian Design for Wearables
summary: Researchers present EpiCoach, an agentic system that treats an individual athlete as the subject of accountable N-of-1 science using consumer wearable data.

title: JEDI Compression for In-Context Imitation Learning
summary: JEDI compresses robot demonstrations into latent slots to preserve execution details and support many-shot context in in-context imitation learning.

title: Enersea and Carbon Haven Partner for North Sea CO2 Injection
summary: Enersea and Carbon Haven are developing an offshore CO2 injection solution to repurpose depleted gas platforms for permanent carbon storage.
